episodes.observedTrigger: The v3 Observatory measured 10,000 neighborhood-resolution record visits on a warmed repeated targeted-cognition workload despite a sparse 23,559-byte output view.
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Build one semantic family index over stable derived geometry and reuse it for repeated target-neighborhood activation instead of rescanning all centers twice.
episodes.observedOutcome: On the same 5,000-center workload, warmed neighborhood-resolution record visits fell from 10,000 to 0; projected payload remained 23,559 bytes; declared routing accuracy remained 1.0; complexity-capacity witness remained 5,000; no verified regression was observed; the reconciled whole-kernel CI passed.
boundaryConditions: The verified gain is amortized on repeated lookups after a one-pass cold index build.
The metric covers neighborhood-resolution record visits, not total reasoner work or physical energy.
Normal runtime safety depends on derived geometry replacing its centers array when geometry-relevant truth changes; tests verify array replacement invalidates the cache.
episodes.falsifier: On the same workload, indexed activation loses a required semantic neighbor, fails cache invalidation, increases another verified dimension materially, or whole-kernel behavior regresses.
